title: Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions Service Recovery Schedule
content:
For Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions, four figures per subscription govern money returned in connection with covered bags and seats: the window before the purchase date within which bag fees already paid on flown directions are refunded, the window before the purchase date within which seat fees already paid on unflown segments are refunded, the amount refunded when a covered bag or seat was charged in error and the charge could not be reversed on the ticket, and whether a covered seat lost to an involuntary reassignment earns anything beyond reassignment to another covered seat.

| Subscription | Bag fees on flown directions refunded when paid within this many calendar days before the purchase date | Seat fees on unflown segments refunded when paid within this many calendar days before the purchase date | Refund per occurrence when a covered bag or seat was charged in error and the charge could not be reversed on the ticket (USD) | Covered seat lost to involuntary reassignment earns more than another covered seat |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Bag Pass One | 7 | 0 | 0 | No |
| Crestline Bag Pass Two | 7 | 0 | 0 | No |
| Crestline Seat Pass Domestic | 0 | 7 | 0 | No |
| Crestline Seat Pass Network | 0 | 7 | 0 | No |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Domestic | 7 | 7 | 0 | No |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Network | 7 | 7 | 0 | No |

## Notes to the schedule

- **Bag fee window.** 7 calendar days for the two Bag Passes and the two Seat and Bag Passes; 0 for the two Seat Passes, which cover no bags.
- **Seat fee window.** 7 calendar days for the two Seat Passes and the two Seat and Bag Passes; 0 for the two Bag Passes, which cover no seats.
- **Charge in error that could not be reversed on the ticket.** The amount is 0 USD per occurrence for every subscription.
- **Involuntary seat reassignment.** For every subscription the answer is No: a covered seat lost to an involuntary reassignment earns nothing beyond reassignment to another covered seat.
